about: Every Betfair football match from 30 minutes to 36 hours ahead. 'best_value' is the best model value across every bet type (value = model chance x Betfair price after 5% commission; above 1.0 beats the price). 'strength_gaps' are matches where one side is clearly stronger on points per game, with that side's win, Asian handicap and corner prices. 'rule_qualifiers' pass Don's two rules and are for the scoreboard only. 'matches' has every match with stats; 'no_stats' are Betfair matches in leagues the free stats feed does not cover, to research by hand. Prices are Betfair back prices at scan time.
